name: Exit Ticket
description: One to three quick questions students answer as they arrive or before they leave. No waiting for the whole class: the room opens straight into the questions, the join code stays on the projector, and you read the answers privately on the console or the activity report.
tagline: Perfect for the last five minutes, a warm-up check, or a quick vibe check.

questions.label: Questions
questions.helper: One to three short questions. Each gets its own answer box on the student's screen.

anonymous.label: Anonymous answers
anonymous.helper: On: students join without a name and get a play name like Amber Fox, so you see the answers without knowing who wrote them.

thanks.label: What students see when they are done
thanks.default: Thanks, that is all we need from you. You can put your device away.

template.name: Exit Ticket
template.description: Quick questions students answer on their own time. Answers stay private to you.

ticket.prompt: Answer in a sentence or two.

end.message: That is everyone. Thanks for the honest answers.
